title: Sa October 19, puwede nang pumili ng plate number ang maraming motorcycle riders sa Japan
summary: For the first time, Japan will open its national 希望ナンバー system to eligible motorcycles. Starting October 19, riders of most bikes above 125cc can apply for their preferred four-digit number, while especially popular numbers will be allocated by weekly lottery.
why_it_matters: Small change ito, pero practical at madaling ma-miss: riders buying, re-registering, or replacing eligible motorcycle plates now gain a choice long available to car owners. The change also comes with a new plate format designed to expand the available number combinations.

claims.text: Applications for Japan's motorcycle choice-number system begin October 19, 2026, online or at designated counters.

Eligible vehicles include small motorcycles over 250cc and light motorcycles over 125cc through 250cc; motorcycles at or below 125cc are outside this national system because their plates are issued by municipalities.
Applicants can choose the four Arabic numerals displayed on the motorcycle plate; 11 numbers are subject to a nationwide weekly lottery, with additional region-specific lottery numbers.
The application charge is ¥2,500–¥3,000 per plate depending on region.

MLIT's earlier working group said some regions risked exhausting available motorcycle plate combinations; redesigning the format substantially increases combinations and enabled consideration of the choice-number system.
For riders already planning a qualifying registration or plate change, waiting until the October 19 application opening may be worthwhile if the displayed number matters to them.
claims.basis: Practical implication of the announced opening date; not a government recommendation.

claims.text: All motorcycles can use the new system.
claims.basis: Rejected: motorcycles at or below 125cc and specified business/rental categories are excluded.

content.whats_new: October 19 ang actual application opening. Eligible riders can request a preferred one-to-four-digit display number online or at a counter. Hindi lang cosmetic ang backend change: MLIT also changed motorcycle plate formats because the old combination pool was becoming tight in some regions.
content.key_message: May choice number na rin ang eligible motorcycles sa Japan—pero hindi kasama ang 125cc-and-below municipal plates.
content.skeptical_view: Hindi ito major transport reform at walang safety or cost-of-living benefit by itself. It is mainly a convenience/personalization change. Also, popular numbers are not guaranteed: 1, 7, 8, 88, 333, 358, 555, 777, 888, 1111 and 8888 are nationwide lottery numbers, and some regions add more.
content.what_next: Applications open October 19. Check the official 希望番号・図柄ナンバープレート申込 service or a local motorcycle shop/registration counter for your area's exact fee and any regional lottery numbers.
content.what_would_change_mind: A later MLIT notice changing the October 19 start, eligibility, fees or lottery list would require an update.
content.recommendation: WATCH if you own or plan to register an eligible motorcycle and care about the plate number; otherwise this needs no action.
content.bottom_line: Car owners have had this option for years. From October 19, many motorcycle riders finally get it too—above 125cc, with exclusions, and popular numbers decided by lottery.
